# plumcut
> plumcut builds and runs the AI that sells on WhatsApp for high-traffic DTC brands, then turns customer conversations into owned customer insight.

## Core Pages
- [Home](https://plumcut.com/): The AI that answers, sells, books, and reads customer conversations for insight.
- [How it works](https://plumcut.com/how-it-works): The done-for-you process: learn the brand, build and launch plum, then run and improve it.
- [Solutions](https://plumcut.com/solutions): AI selling, instant answers, booking, order tracking, payments, and customer insights for WhatsApp.
- [Pricing](https://plumcut.com/pricing): Custom pricing based on real message volume, setup scope, and selected solutions.
- [About](https://plumcut.com/about): plumcut's MENA-native founding team and origin story.

## Field notes
- [Field notes](https://plumcut.com/blog/): Practical guides on WhatsApp automation, AI that sells, and customer insight you own.
<!-- BLOG:LIST:START -->
- [When Is Your Business Ready for AI Customer Service?](https://plumcut.com/blog/when-ready-for-ai-customer-service): Most advice tells you how to automate, never whether you should yet. The three signals that say you are ready, and the honest case for waiting.
- [Manual Order Entry vs Automated Order Capture in Delivery Software](https://plumcut.com/blog/manual-order-entry-vs-automated-capture): Four ways an order gets from a customer message into your delivery or fleet dashboard, compared on error rate, speed, cost and where each one breaks.
- [How to Connect WhatsApp Orders to Your Fleet Management Software](https://plumcut.com/blog/connect-whatsapp-orders-fleet-software): What it takes for an order placed in a WhatsApp conversation to appear in a fleet dashboard by itself, and how logistics vendors can offer it.
- [What to Automate First in an Ecommerce Business](https://plumcut.com/blog/what-to-automate-first-ecommerce): Automation pays back in a specific order. The sequence that works for a MENA or Gulf online store, what to leave manual, and how to tell which is which.
- [Does Automating Your Store's Conversations Actually Make Money?](https://plumcut.com/blog/does-conversation-automation-increase-sales): Vendor ROI numbers are unverifiable. Here is the arithmetic to run on your own four numbers, and the three places conversation automation genuinely moves revenue.
- [Automating Delivery Updates and the Courier Loop](https://plumcut.com/blog/automate-logistics-delivery-updates): The operations side of order tracking: courier data quality, failed attempts, cash on delivery reattempts, and why a sent message is not a delivered one.
- [Automating the Back Office of a Small Commerce Team](https://plumcut.com/blog/automate-internal-operations-commerce): Order handovers, staff questions, approvals and the weekly report. The internal half of store automation, and which parts are worth wiring up first.
- [How to Automate Customer Service Without Losing the Customer](https://plumcut.com/blog/automate-customer-service-without-losing-customers): Automated support fails at the handover, not the answer. How to design escalation, meet Meta's policy requirement, and keep the relationship you already have.
- [Can AI Answer Where Is My Order on WhatsApp in 2026?](https://plumcut.com/blog/where-is-my-order-whatsapp): The most common message in commerce is a tracking question. What it takes to answer it automatically on WhatsApp, what it costs, and where it breaks.
- [What the WhatsApp Business API Really Costs in 2026](https://plumcut.com/blog/whatsapp-business-api-cost): Separate Meta message charges from provider fees, software and implementation. Understand the free windows and compare the total cost of WhatsApp automation.
- [WhatsApp AI for Shopify Stores in Lebanon and the Gulf](https://plumcut.com/blog/whatsapp-ai-shopify-lebanon-gulf): Why MENA Shopify stores sell in WhatsApp instead of the checkout, what breaks when you automate it, and what a working setup looks like.
- [Can You Send Abandoned Cart Messages on WhatsApp?](https://plumcut.com/blog/whatsapp-abandoned-cart-rules): Yes, with opt in and an approved marketing template. Meta lists cart reminders as marketing, so the advice to file them as utility is wrong and costly.
- [The Best WhatsApp Automation Tools in 2026, Honestly Compared](https://plumcut.com/blog/best-whatsapp-automation-tools): Compare WhatsApp platforms and managed services by AI capability, setup responsibility, integration needs and cost, with current vendor sources.
- [Does AI Customer Service Really Work in Arabic in 2026?](https://plumcut.com/blog/ai-customer-service-arabic): Dialect, Arabizi and code switching break most Arabic automation. What works for Gulf and Levant brands, and why templates are a separate job.
- [How to Automate WhatsApp for Your Business in 2026](https://plumcut.com/blog/how-to-automate-whatsapp-for-your-business): A practical walkthrough of WhatsApp automation for commerce brands, from the free Business app to the Cloud API, and how to pick the right level.
<!-- BLOG:LIST:END -->

## Key Facts
- plumcut is built in Lebanon for MENA and international commerce brands.
- plum is a managed AI conversation layer, not a self-serve bot builder.
- The current beachhead is high-traffic DTC fashion and retail brands.
- The core promise is revenue recovery plus customer understanding the merchant owns.
- Founders: Nour, Charbel, and Michael.
